chapter: Harlem, Redman's band and the Savoy
title: Truehart, Jimmy Blanton and musicians lost to tuberculosis
summary: Truehart and Jimmy Blanton died of tuberculosis; Hinton visited Blanton in a California hospital in 1942.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: -- until he died, you know. He died, like some of the other great musicians at that time, they died of tuberculosis.
Medical science hadn't got to that yet.
Yeah, they had no cure for it, just rest. We didn't have very many --
Just like I know you remember Blanton.
I remember when we was in California in '42 and you used to go to see him at the hospital. Every day you used to go see him.
Unbelievable bassist. He died at 22 years old.
